name: Add Manual Location Input
description:
if you navigate to the website on local 
and when we see the sun and moon position , it didn't load the position is there any issue , fix it , all functioanlity are working fine except these 2
http://localhost:4321/sun-position/
http://localhost:4321/moon-position/

goal.answer: Enable users to manually enter location (city or coordinates) on sun and moon position pages when automatic detection fails or for testing different locations.

criteria.answer:
Sun and moon position pages show a manual input field for location (city or coordinates) alongside the automatic detection
User can enter a city name or coordinates and submit via button or Enter key
Submission updates the location and triggers the sun/moon position data to refresh
The displayed sun/moon data (direction, altitude, times) updates correctly based on the entered location
Automatic location detection still works as a fallback

constraints.answer: Must maintain existing automatic location detection functionality, Should work with both dark and light themes, Must not break existing location-based features on other pages, Input validation should handle invalid coordinates gracefully

assumptions.answer: The existing geo library can be extended to support forward geocoding (city/coordinates to lat/lng). The LocationPrompt component can be modified to include manual input without breaking existing functionality. The sun/moon position pages use the same location update mechanism as the compass page.

phases.name: Implement Manual Location Input
phases.goal: Add manual location input capability to sun and moon position pages
phases.description: Modify LocationPrompt component to include manual input fields for city/coordinates, add forward geocoding capability to geo library, and ensure proper integration with sun/moon position pages.

steps.description: Extend geo library with forward geocoding function to convert city names or coordinates to latitude/longitude

verification.command: node -e "import { forwardGeocode } from './src/lib/geo.ts'; console.log('Forward geocode function exists')" || echo "Need to implement forwardGeocode function"

steps.description: Modify LocationPrompt component to add manual input fields (text input for city/coordinates, submit button) while preserving existing automatic detection UI

verification.command: grep -n "manual location input" src/components/LocationPrompt.astro && echo "Manual input fields added" || echo "Need to add manual input fields"

steps.description: Update sun-position.astro and moon-position.astro to pass manual location handling props to LocationPrompt

verification.command: grep -n "manualLocation" src/pages/sun-position.astro src/pages/moon-position.astro && echo "Manual location props configured" || echo "Need to configure manual location props"

steps.description: Implement form submission handling in LocationPrompt to process user input, validate, and trigger location updates via existing mountLocationManager mechanism

verification.command: grep -n "handleManualSubmit" src/components/LocationPrompt.astro && echo "Submit handler implemented" || echo "Need to implement submit handler"

steps.description: Test that entered location updates sun/moon position data correctly and automatic detection still works as fallback

verification.command: npm run dev && [manual verification of functionality] || echo "Manual verification needed"
